# ASO Studio

> Self-hosted App Store toolkit for indie iOS developers: keyword rank tracking, Apple Ads analytics, screenshots/PPO, video ads and In-App Events. It runs as one local gateway on :5173. Open source and agent-friendly, and pairs with Claude Code via MCP servers.

## Features

- [README](https://github.com/dsm5e/aso-tracker#readme): What ASO Studio is and what it does
- [Full LLM context](llms-full.txt): Architecture, file map, state schema, recipes for AI agents

## Products

- **Keywords** (`/`): rank tracking in 175 storefronts from native App Store search order (up to 250 deep); country matrix, positions, ideas, competitor spy, nightly delta refresh behind a per-host adaptive rate gate
- **Ads** (`/asa/`): Apple Ads keyword economics, traffic intelligence, keyword popularity (5–100); read-only by default
- **Screenshots** (`/studio/`): App Store screenshot generator with AI polish (fal.ai gpt-image-2), PPO treatment generator, icon variants
- **Video** (`/video/`): node-based UGC video-ad pipeline
- **In-App** (`/inapp/`): In-App Event card/detail designer

## Stack

- React 19 + Vite + TypeScript (frontend)
- Express + better-sqlite3 + Sharp (backend), one-port gateway `studio/server.ts` with lazy product activation
- Data under `~/.aso-studio/` (outside the repo)
